title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 28: David's charge to Israel and to Solomon, and the plans for the temple he gave him.

questions.text: To which city did David assemble all the princes and mighty men of Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:1 says David assembled all the princes of Israel and the mighty men to Jerusalem.

answers.text: Hebron
Jerusalem
Shiloh
Bethel

questions.text: David said it was in his heart to build a house of rest for what?
questions.explanation: David said it was in his heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh's covenant, and for the footstool of our God.

answers.text: The ark of Yahweh's covenant
The royal treasures
The captains of the army
The family of the king

questions.text: Why did God tell David that he should not build a house for his name?
questions.explanation: God said to David that he should not build a house for his name because he was a man of war and had shed blood.

answers.text: He was too old to finish the work
He had not prepared anything for the building
He was not from the tribe of Judah
He was a man of war and had shed blood

questions.text: Which tribe did David say Yahweh had chosen to be prince?
questions.explanation: David said Yahweh had chosen Judah to be prince, and in the house of Judah the house of his father.

answers.text: Levi
Benjamin
Judah
Ephraim

questions.text: What did God say about Solomon when he said Solomon would build his house?
questions.explanation: God said, "I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father."

answers.text: I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father
He shall be a man of war like his father
He shall be a prophet like Samuel
He shall rule over Israel for seven years only

questions.text: On what condition did God say he would establish Solomon's kingdom forever?
questions.explanation: God said he would establish Solomon's kingdom forever if he continued to do his commandments and his ordinances.

answers.text: If he defeated all the Philistines
If he continued to do God's commandments and ordinances
If he finished the house within seven years
If he made peace with the king of Egypt

questions.text: What did David tell Solomon would happen if he sought Yahweh?
questions.explanation: David told Solomon, "If you seek him, he will be found by you."

answers.text: He will give you a hundred sons
He will make you a prophet
He will give you the land of Egypt
He will be found by you

questions.text: What did David give to Solomon his son in verse 11?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:11 says David gave Solomon the plans for the porch of the temple, its houses, its treasuries, its upper rooms, its inner rooms, and the place of the mercy seat.

answers.text: His own sword and shield
The crown of King Saul
The plans for the temple and its rooms
The keys of the city of David

questions.text: How did David say he had been made to understand all the works of the pattern?
questions.explanation: David said, "All this I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh's hand."

answers.text: In writing from Yahweh's hand
Through a dream at night
From the words of the elders
From the plans of the king of Tyre

questions.text: What did David promise Solomon about Yahweh God?
questions.explanation: David said Yahweh would not fail Solomon nor forsake him until all the work for the service of Yahweh's house was finished.

answers.text: He would finish the work in seven years
He would send angels to build the house
He would not fail or forsake him until the work was finished
He would give him the help of Pharaoh
